cards.name: Numb the Pain

lines: "Whenever you suffer damage this round, if your current hit point value is half your maximum or less, suffer 1 less damage."

custom: top: this round, each time you suffer damage while at half your maximum hit points or less, suffer 1 less damage
cards.notes: Class-wide: card numbers are printed with a 'G' prefix (G 0323 to G 0350, in input order); recorded here without the prefix. Initiative printed as '09'. The input has no GHS or Xipe data for this class, so every card is 'missing' in both.

cards.name: Defiance of Death

lines: "You may suffer damage 2 to add +2 Attack and gain XP 1."
"On the next source of damage you would suffer that would reduce your current hit point value to less than 1, negate the damage."
slots: 1 (dashed, XP 1 on slot 1), ends after the last

custom: top: optional: suffer damage 2 for +2 Attack and XP 1
bottom: persistent, one use: negate the next source of damage that would take you below 1 hit point; XP 1 when used
cards.notes: Bottom corner shows only the persistent icon (no lost icon), so the card is discarded when the use is spent.

cards.name: Resolute Stand

lines: "Gain XP 1 the next time you retaliate this round."

custom: top: XP 1 the next time you retaliate this round
cards.notes: Top: the consume Fire box (Heal 2, self) is the first row, its own ability before the Retaliate. Bottom Move 4 has no enhancement mark.

cards.name: Blood Pact

lines: ! "Suffer damage equal to half your current hit point value (rounded down)."
! "At the start of each of your turns, if your current hit point value is greater than 1, suffer damage 1."

custom: top: mandatory self-damage of half your current hit points (rounded down) before the attack
bottom: persistent: +1 Attack on all your attacks; at the start of each of your turns, suffer damage 1 if above 1 hit point (mandatory)
cards.notes: The bottom's start-of-turn damage matches GHS's character special action 'blood-pact' (hint: 'At the start of each of your turns, if your current hit point value is greater than 1, suffer 1 damage', expire: true). The persistent bottom has no end condition printed (lasts until the scenario ends or the card leaves the active area).

cards.name: From the Brink

lines: "Remove all negative conditions you have. If your current hit point value is 1, you may recover one card from your lost pile."
"Set your current hit point value to half of your maximum (rounded up) and gain Strengthen."

cards.name: Careless Charge

lines: "If you moved in a straight line in one direction with the move ability and you do not have Wound, gain Wound to add +X Attack, where X is the number of hexes you moved with the move ability."
"Whenever you are attacked this round, gain Retaliate X for the attack, where X is the number of enemies adjacent to you when the attack is performed."

custom: top: if the move went in a straight line in one direction and you lack Wound, you gain Wound and the attack gets +X Attack (X = hexes moved with that move)
bottom: this round, Retaliate X against each attack on you, X = enemies adjacent to you when the attack is performed
cards.notes: Top: the conditional text sits in a dashed box linked to the attack (no element icon). Whether gaining Wound is optional when the condition holds is not stated beyond 'gain Wound to add'.

"You may perform this action any number of times in succession, increasing the damage suffered by 1 each time."

cards.name: Bathe in Blood

lines: "Whenever you suffer damage, all enemies that have Wound suffer damage 1."

custom: top: persistent: whenever you suffer damage, every enemy with Wound suffers damage 1
cards.notes: Bottom: Pull and Muddle are their own abilities (no attack); the range mark is printed on the pill after 'range 2'.

mechanics: Optional self-damage for a bonus, 'You may suffer damage 2 to ...': +2 Attack and XP 1 (Defiance of Death top), Stun and XP 1 (Dazing Wound top), Wound+Immobilize range 1 (Cauterize bottom), +1 Target and XP 1 (Reckless Offensive top), infuse Fire and Stun range 1 (Into the Fight bottom), +2 Attack (Seeing Red top), +2 Move and XP 1 (Fueled by Pain bottom), +1 Retaliate and XP 1 (Spiked Armor top), +1 Attack and XP 1 (Burning Hatred top)
Chosen self-damage as X: 'You may suffer up to damage N', X = damage chosen: Move 4+X, up to 3 (Strength in Agony bottom); Attack X on all enemies within 3 hexes, up to 4 (Flurry of Axes top)

Low-health threshold 'if your current hit point value is half your maximum or less' (bonus + XP 1 or extra action): Numb the Pain top, Strength in Agony top, Cauterize top, Growing Rage top and bottom, Reckless Offensive bottom, Into the Fight top, Inner Fire top, Seeing Red top, Bone Breaker top, Spiked Armor bottom

Mandatory self-damage / hit point setting: half current HP (Blood Pact top), 1 per turn start while above 1 HP (Blood Pact bottom), set HP to 1 (Glass Hammer top), set HP to half maximum rounded up (From the Brink top), damage 1 that cannot be negated, growing by 1 per repeat (Burning Hatred bottom)

Damage reduction/negation: suffer 1 less damage while at half HP or less, this round (Numb the Pain top); negate the next lethal source, 1 use (Defiance of Death bottom); negate the next damage this round (Spiked Armor top)
Round bonus 'gain XP 1 the next time you retaliate this round' (Resolute Stand top, Unbridled Power bottom, Tireless Retribution top)

Retaliate-triggered effects: Heal 1 self on each retaliate, repeat once if still at half HP or less (Growing Rage top, persistent); enemies damaged by your retaliate gain Wound (Spiked Armor top); Retaliate X = adjacent enemies (Careless Charge bottom)

Damage-suffered triggers: Attack 4 after each of the next six sources of damage while an enemy is adjacent (Vengeful Barrage top, 6 slots, lost); all wounded enemies suffer damage 1 whenever you suffer damage (Bathe in Blood top, persistent)

Fire is the class element: infuse Fire (Shiny Distraction, Cauterize, From the Brink, Tireless Retribution, Inner Fire, Devil Horns, Bone Breaker); consume Fire (Resolute Stand, Unbridled Power, Reckless Offensive, Final Fight, Unstoppable Destruction, Seeing Red, Vengeful Barrage, Fueled by Pain, Burning Hatred); consume Fire to reach farther: melee attack targets enemies up to two hexes away instead (Unbridled Power top, Seeing Red bottom, Burning Hatred top)

Self-Wound as a resource and Wound-matters: gain Wound for +X Attack after a straight-line move (Careless Charge top); attack all wounded enemies moved through (Fueled by Pain bottom); Bathe in Blood top

Advantage/disadvantage round effects: advantage on all your attacks this round (Shiny Distraction bottom), attacks on you gain disadvantage this round (Shiny Distraction bottom, Tireless Retribution top); Attack 5 with advantage (Final Fight top)

X values: Attack X = current HP plus XP 1 per 5 damage dealt to an enemy (Glass Hammer top); Heal X = damage enemies suffered from the attack (Fueled by Pain top); +X Attack = hexes moved in a straight line (Careless Charge top)
Exhaust-on-lost persistent: attack at the end of this and the next three turns, then you become exhausted when the card goes to the lost pile (Final Fight top)
Short rest gives all long rest benefits this round (Tireless Retribution bottom)
Recover one lost card if at exactly 1 HP, remove negative conditions, set HP to half max, Strengthen (From the Brink top)
Repeatable action with growing self-damage (Burning Hatred bottom)
Character token on an enemy: target loses Flying (Bone Breaker bottom, persistent)
Area-damage rider: enemies adjacent to the target but not to you suffer damage 2 (Unstoppable Destruction top)
Unrecoverable lost halves (card stack with red X icon): Flurry of Axes top, Burning Hatred bottom
No summons; conditions used: Wound, Immobilize, Stun, Muddle, Strengthen, plus advantage/disadvantage; no Ward/Safeguard
unclear: Flurry of Axes top, Burning Hatred bottom: the card-stack-with-red-X corner icon is read as 'unrecoverable' (as other 2e sheets do); the 2e rule for it was not checked
Bone Breaker bottom: persistent with no printed end; what the character token does beyond 'the target loses Flying' and when it ends (target death?) is not on the card
Blood Pact bottom: persistent with no printed end (GHS's special action marks it 'expire')
Careless Charge top: whether gaining Wound is optional once the straight-line condition holds ('gain Wound to add +X Attack') is a rules question
Spiked Armor top: whether the optional 'suffer damage 2' can be negated by the same half's 'negate the next damage you suffer this round' depends on resolution order (rules question)
Final Fight bottom: the round icon sits inside the consume Fire box, not in the half's corner; read as 'the +1 Attack lasts this round', summary left empty
